title: Renew an industry participant and promoter registration
summary: You can renew your industry participant and promoter registration online to carry out combat sports activities in NSW.
intro:
You can apply online to renew your industry participant and promoter registration to carry out an activity at combat sports contests in NSW. This can be done online from 8 weeks before your registration expiry date.

Registration expires 3 years from the date granted, unless cancelled earlier, or the term extended or reduced.
who_can_apply: You must have submitted a complete application.
Your registration must not have expired.
You must not be a controlled member of a declared organisation under the Crimes (Criminal Organisations Control) Act 2012.
what_you_need: Your renewal number (including all digits and letters, as shown on your renewal reminder notice)
A recent passport size photograph (JPG/PNG format, maximum file size 10MB)
Successful completion of training relating to the management of concussions and head injuries
Trainer applicants also need a Referee, judge and timekeeper applicant also need, and Promoter, manager and matchmaker applicants also need.

how_to_steps.text: Gather the required details and documents.
Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Enter your registration and renewal numbers, these can be found on your renewal notice.
Follow the prompts to renew your industry participant and promoter registration.

more_info.text: You'll get an industry participant identity card mailed to your postal address within 10 business days.

Applications for promoter, manager and matchmaker are referred to the Police Commissioner for a security determination. This may take several weeks. Promoters must allow sufficient time for their application to be considered. It is an offence to arrange a combat sport contest unless registered in the appropriate promoter class.
If you need to update your details, go to Change name or contact details on an industry participant and promoter registration.

You can only renew industry participant and promoter class(es) already held on your registration. We recommend completing a Manage industry participant and promoter classes transaction after your renewal application is approved if you need to update your registration classes.
To check your industry participant and promoter registration number and details, visit Verify NSW.

faqs.q: How long is the registration valid for?
faqs.a: The registration is valid for 3 years from the date it was granted, unless it is cancelled or the term is extended or reduced.

faqs.q: When can I renew my registration?
faqs.a: You can apply online to renew your registration starting 8 weeks before your expiry date.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to renew their registration?
faqs.a: You can renew if you have submitted a complete application and your registration has not expired. You must also not be a controlled member of a declared organisation under the Crimes (Criminal Organisations Control) Act 2012.
